newsitem.title: GERMANY: Veba denies in talks with Mobil over Aral stake.
newsitem.headline: Veba denies in talks with Mobil over Aral stake.

text.p: German diversified industrial group Veba AG on Wednesday denied market speculation that it was in discussions to acquire oil company Mobil Corp's stake in the petrol-station chain Aral.
"We are not happy with the situation as it stands, as we have said previously, but there are no discussions on the Mobil stake under way at the moment," a Veba spokeswoman told Reuters.
Veba has a 56 percent stake in Aral.
The market speculation comes in the wake of the downstream link-up between the two oil giants Mobil Corp and BP Plc in February last year.
Mobil is on the Aral supervisory board and Veba has said previously that it fears that BP will have access to important strategic information through its partnership with Mobil.
